title: Vacuum Cleaners: TechRadar Tested Picks
desc: Seven hands-on tested model recommendations from TechRadar, each selected for a different use case. The numbered order follows the article and does not compare unlike vacuum types on one common score.

source.name: TechRadar — The best vacuum cleaners you can buy right now (updated 19 Oct 2026)
source.note: All seven model names, article positions, award/use-case labels, and descriptions were checked against the full linked TechRadar guide by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-10-21. The guide combines different vacuum types and use cases, so its numbered display is not a single comparable lab-score ranking.

items.name: Shark PowerDetect Cordless
items.detail: Best for most people; tested strongly across cleaning tasks, including pet hair.

items.name: Dreame R20
items.detail: Best lightweight; nimble, well-equipped and top-scoring in the source’s cordless group test.

items.name: Bissell PowerClean FurFinder
items.detail: Best budget; practical cleaning performance at a lower price.

items.name: Shark Stratos Pet Pro Upright Vacuum
items.detail: Best upright; corded power and larger dust cup.

items.name: Dyson Gen5detect
items.detail: Best premium; feature-rich cordless model with strong cleaning.

items.name: Roborock Saros 20
items.detail: Best robot vacuum; source recommends for hands-off regular cleaning.

items.name: Dreame Z30 Pro Aqua
items.detail: Best vacuum-and-mop; cordless stick model with wet-dry floor cleaning.
